description: This file is a Bash script used for installing, configuring, and testing the OpenClaw system in an end-to-end testing environment. It includes environment setup, validation of API keys, npm package version resolution, installer execution, model configuration, and a complex sequence of agent interactions and verification steps.

methods.name: set_image_model
methods.description: Attempts to set the image model for a given profile from a list of candidates.

methods.name: set_agent_model
methods.description: Attempts to set the agent model for a given profile from a list of candidates.

methods.name: write_png_lr_rg
methods.description: Generates a PNG image with left and right side colors (red and green) and saves it to a file.

methods.name: run_agent_turn
methods.description: Runs an agent turn with the specified profile, session, prompt, and output file.

methods.name: assert_agent_json_has_text
methods.description: Verifies that the agent's JSON output contains non-empty text payloads.

methods.name: assert_agent_json_ok
methods.description: Checks that the agent's JSON output denotes a successful response and correct provider.

methods.name: extract_matching_text
methods.description: Extracts a specific or first matching text payload from the agent's JSON output.

methods.name: assert_session_used_tools
methods.description: Verifies that specific tools were used during the session by analyzing the transcript.

methods.name: run_profile
methods.description: Sets up and tests an agent profile including onboarding, environment checks, and interaction sequences.
